predecessors.name: Eritrean People's Liberation Front
predecessors.text: Eritrea: the EPLF 'defeated the Ethiopian forces in Eritrea'; infobox 'De facto: 24 May 1991'

predecessors.name: Ethiopia
predecessors.text: Eritrea, federated with Ethiopia in 1952 and annexed in 1962; independence 'De jure: 24 May 1993' from Ethiopia

ledger.x: 1991: Eritrea becomes independent in fact after thirty years of war.
1998: Eritrean and Ethiopian troops fight over Badme.
1999: the fighting spreads to the Tsorona front.
2000: Ethiopia's offensive takes the Western front.
2000: the Algiers peace ends the fighting over Badme.
2000: the Algiers peace ends the fighting on the Tsorona front.
2000: the Algiers peace ends the fighting on the Western front.
2000: the Algiers peace closes the Zalambessa front.

wars.name: Eritrean-Ethiopian War
wars.outcome: Fighting ended with the 12 December 2000 Algiers peace agreement; on 14 April 2002 the boundary commission's 'final and binding' ruling awarded Badme to Eritrea, but Ethiopian forces held it until 2020.

wars.name: Tigray War
wars.outcome: 'In 2020, Eritrean troops intervened in the Tigray War on the side of the Ethiopian government'; 'In April 2021, Eritrea confirmed its troops were fighting in Ethiopia'.

certainty.note: Undelimited frontier with Ethiopia (the Badme conflict 'was not resolved until 2018'); the Red Sea islands (Hanish, Doumeira) are disputed with Yemen and Djibouti.
